charts.name: Container Memory Usage vs Limit (GB)
charts.programText:
(data('container_memory_working_set_bytes', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('pod', 'kraftcontroller-0')) / 1024/1024/1024).publish(label='Usage')
(data('kube_pod_container_resource_limits', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('pod', 'kraftcontroller-0') and filter('resource', 'memory') and filter('container', 'kraftcontroller')) / 1024/1024/1024).publish(label='Limit')

charts.name: Memory %
charts.programText:
a = data('container_memory_working_set_bytes', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('pod', 'kraftcontroller-0')).sum()
b = data('kube_pod_container_resource_limits', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('pod', 'kraftcontroller-0') and filter('resource', 'memory') and filter('container', 'kraftcontroller')).sum()
(a/b*100).publish(label='Memory %')

charts.name: CPU Usage vs Limit (cores)
charts.description: container_cpu_usage_seconds_total (2-minute timeshift delta, not .rate() - see repo notes) vs kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource=cpu}.
charts.programText:
raw = data('container_cpu_usage_seconds_total', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('pod', 'kraftcontroller-0'))
((raw - raw.timeshift('2m')) / 120).publish(label='Usage')
limit = data('kube_pod_container_resource_limits', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('pod', 'kraftcontroller-0') and filter('resource', 'cpu') and filter('container', 'kraftcontroller'))
limit.publish(label='Limit')

charts.name: CPU %
charts.description: CPU cores used (2-minute timeshift delta) / kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource=cpu}, as a percentage.
charts.programText:
raw = data('container_cpu_usage_seconds_total', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('pod', 'kraftcontroller-0')).sum()
usage = (raw - raw.timeshift('2m')) / 120
limit = data('kube_pod_container_resource_limits', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('pod', 'kraftcontroller-0') and filter('resource', 'cpu') and filter('container', 'kraftcontroller')).sum()
(usage/limit*100).publish(label='CPU %')

charts.name: GC Time (% of wall-clock)
charts.description: 2-minute timeshift delta of jvm_gc_collection_seconds_sum, as % of wall-clock time.
charts.programText:
raw = data('jvm_gc_collection_seconds_sum', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-controller') and filter('service.instance.id', 'kraftcontroller-0'))
(((raw - raw.timeshift('2m')) / 120) * 100).publish(label='GC Time %')
